speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Here. October, and the twenty-second, and a moon with no hour beside it. I am not writing one in to please the cloth.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I did not ask you to please the cloth. I asked you not to become a statue between me and my own morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not a statue. The margin is empty. I am leaving it empty. That is the whole of the reading.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then shut it. The half of the hour is walking past the porch while you admire an empty margin. I can hear the street. I would like to hear the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut. Empty. And I am going, before you put the cloth down, which you will not do, and which I am not going to require.
